parameters.name: AccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be discontinued.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The value of **ClientToken** can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: MigrationJobId
parameters.description: Instance ID of the data migration instance. You can call the **DescribeMigrationJobs** operation to query instance ID.

parameters.name: MigrationMode.DataInitialization
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to query the details of full data migration. Valid values:

- **true**: yes.
- **false**: no.
> Default value: **false**.

parameters.name: MigrationMode.DataSynchronization
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to query the details of incremental data migration. Valid values:

- **true**: yes.
- **false**: no.
> Default value: **false**.

parameters.name: MigrationMode.StructureInitialization
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to query the details of schema migration. Valid values:

- **true**: yes.
- **false**: no.
> Default value: **false**.

parameters.name: PageNum
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be an integer greater than **0** and must not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of records per page. Valid values: **30**, **50**, and **100**. Default value: **30**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the data migration instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).
